# Thematic Deep Dive: AI Data Center Power Bottleneck

**Date:** 2026-11-14  
**Author:** Macro & Thematic Strategy Team  
**Source Type:** Thematic Memo

## Theme Summary
**AI Data Center Power Bottleneck** is an accelerating secular narrative: hyperscale AI clusters are shifting from compute-bound to power-and-thermal-bound. Utility grid interconnect queues and rack thermal limits (>100kW/rack) are reshaping winner/loser dynamics across semis and industrials.

## Cross-Company Implications
- **Beneficiaries:** Vertiv (VRT) captures higher dollar content per MW via liquid cooling and switchgear; Eaton (ETN) benefits from medium-voltage transformer shortages.
- **Mixed / Exposed:** NVIDIA (NVDA) faces potential deployment pacing constraints if data center power readiness lags chip shipments, even as demand remains robust.
- **Headwinds:** Legacy AirCool Corp (AIRC), which lacks liquid cooling CDU offerings, is losing share in hyperscale RFPs and is hurt by the transition away from air-only cooling.
